concerns.text: Foundational task **T018** (pin exact dependency versions) is placed after many downstream tasks (e.g., T001‑T007). Foundational setup tasks must precede any task that consumes the environment; move T018 to the beginning of Phase 1.

Task **T019** (amend plan.md to replace GHTorrent references) appears after data acquisition (T002) and other pipeline steps. The plan must be consistent before any data‑acquisition code runs; relocate T019 to precede T001/T002.

Manual‑review fallback (**T017**) is scheduled after the full quick‑start run (T016) and after model training tasks (T010‑T011). It should be positioned before any modeling or evaluation tasks so the pipeline can abort early if bug‑label precision is insufficient.
